meta.title: Wolffish — Your Local AI Agent
meta.description: A local-first, markdown-powered personal AI desktop agent. Your brain, your rules, your machine.

hero.name: Wolffish
hero.subtitle: The personal AI agent that gets out of your way. It acts, automates, and remembers on Mac, Windows, and Linux — fully local or with the model of your choice.

launch.title: Wolffish is live
launch.subtitle: Your personal AI agent — local, private, and built to act. The wait is over.

points.act: Acts on your machine — not just chats
points.markdown: A Markdown brain you can read & edit
points.nocloud: No cloud, no code, no setup

features.localDesc: Runs offline using local models — data never leaves your machine. Your agent's brain is markdown you can read, edit, and version control. No cloud. No code. Full privacy.
features.brainDesc: Built like a human brain — memory, reasoning, and action in one agentic architecture. The agent remembers context, thinks step by step, and acts on your behalf.
features.extensibleDesc: Drop a folder with a SKILL.md to teach your agent something new instantly. Add tools, workflows, or entire capabilities — no config, no setup, just plug and go.
